provenance: AIME 2024, DeepSeek-R1-Zero. Verbatim from DeepSeek-AI 2025: during RL, pass@1 rose from 15.6% to 71.0%; with majority voting (cons@64) it reaches 86.7% (matching OpenAI-o1-0912). Response length grows alongside accuracy. x = RL training step (approx); y = pass@1 (%). Intermediate points are authored along the reported climb, following the figure's saturating shape (fast early gains, flattening past mid-training); the paper's Fig 3 shows response length growing near-linearly throughout, which is the divergence the page plots.
